kaps_punt: Die natuurlike watersiklus: vanaf see na land en terug na die see

items.bewering: Die son skyn op die see en maak die water warm. Van die warm water verander in onsigbare waterdamp en styg op in die lug.
items.blok: Die reis begin by die see
items.bron: USGS Water Science School, 'Evaporation and the Water Cycle' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/evaporation-and-water-cycle): energy (heat) drives evaporation, with the sun as the driver of the cycle, and the oceans as the main source of atmospheric water. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte. 'Van die warm water' se 'n deel van die water, en beweer nie dat net warm water verdamp nie.

items.bewering: Ons noem hierdie eerste stap van die reis verdamping.
items.blok: Die reis begin by die see
items.bron: 'Eerste' is hier 'n volgorde in die verhaal en nie 'n bewering oor die natuur nie. Die les self se later dat 'n siklus geen begin het nie en dat die reis net so goed by 'n wolk kon begin, so dit weerspreek homself nie. Om met verdamping uit die see te begin is in ooreenstemming met USGS: die oseaan is die hoofbron van die meeste water in die atmosfeer (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/oceans-and-seas-and-water-cycle). Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Water verdamp ook uit riviere, damme, nat grond en plante.
items.blok: Die reis begin by die see
items.bron: USGS, 'Evapotranspiration and the Water Cycle' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/evapotranspiration-and-water-cycle): water evaporates from the soil and plant surfaces, and plants release water as vapour through the stomata on their leaves (transpiration). Om dit by Graad 4 'verdamp ... uit plante' te noem, is 'n aanvaarbare vereenvoudiging: transpirasie is die verdamping van water by die blare. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Hoog bo die aarde is dit baie kouer as by die see. Daar koel die waterdamp af en verander weer in klein waterdruppeltjies.
items.bron: LibreTexts Geosciences, 'Layers of the Atmosphere' (https://geo.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Meteorology_and_Climate_Science/Atmospheric_Processes_and_Phenomena/01%3A_Atmospheric_Basics/1.06%3A_Layers_of_the_Atmosphere) and Plymouth State University (https://vortex.plymouth.edu/dept/tutorials/atmosphere/layers.html): in the troposphere, where clouds form, the temperature falls on average by about 6.5 °C per km. Condensation into cloud droplets: USGS condensation page (copy at https://fdacourse.iri.columbia.edu/documents/M1U2_Clouds/Clouds_Readings/S3_Clouds_Readings/S3_Condensation_The_Water_Cycle_USGS.pdf). Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Op 'n warm dag vorm daar ook druppels aan die buitekant van 'n glas koue water. Daardie druppels is waterdamp uit die lug wat teen die koue glas afgekoel het.
items.bron: USGS condensation page (copy at https://fdacourse.iri.columbia.edu/documents/M1U2_Clouds/Clouds_Readings/S3_Clouds_Readings/S3_Condensation_The_Water_Cycle_USGS.pdf) gives droplets on the outside of a cold drink as an everyday example of condensation; the water comes from the air and not through the glass. Mapping checked: in both the cloud and the glass, vapour cools and turns into liquid droplets. The cause of the cooling differs (rising air against contact with a cold surface), but the lesson only says 'afgekoel', so a learner who reasons further reaches nothing false. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Baie van hierdie druppeltjies vorm saam 'n wolk. In die wolk groei die druppeltjies aan mekaar vas en word hulle groter.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, Atmospheric Science, 'Chapter 7: Precipitation Processes' (https://pressbooks-dev.oer.hawaii.edu/atmo/chapter/chapter-7-precipitation-processes/) and LibreTexts '7.02: Cloud Droplets': cloud droplets collide and coalesce (stick together) into larger drops. A cloud is an accumulation of tiny droplets (and ice crystals). Growth through ice crystals, the other main route to rain, is left out. That simplifies the process but is not false. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Wanneer die druppels te swaar word vir die lug om te dra, val hulle uit die wolk na die aarde.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Chapter 7: Precipitation Processes' (https://pressbooks-dev.oer.hawaii.edu/atmo/chapter/chapter-7-precipitation-processes/) and Plymouth State (https://vortex.plymouth.edu/dept/tutorials/precip/precip2aaa.html): a drop falls out of the cloud once its fall speed exceeds the updraft that holds it up. Mapping checked: 'te swaar vir die lug om te dra' matches the rising air no longer holding the drop up, and does not lead a Grade 4 learner somewhere false. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Neerslag val meestal as reën, en as sneeu waar dit koud genoeg is.
items.bron: Journal of Climate 31(10), 2018, 'Global Distribution of Snow Precipitation Features and Their Properties from 3 Years of GPM Observations' (https://journals.ametsoc.org/view/journals/clim/31/10/jcli-d-17-0012.1.xml), citing Levizzani et al. (2011): only about 5% of global precipitation falls as snow, so most of it is rain. 'Meestal' holds. Hail and sleet are not named, but 'meestal' leaves room for them. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Van die water vloei in strome en riviere en in mere en vleilande in. Ander water trek diep in die grond in en word ondergrondse water.
items.bron: USGS, 'Runoff: Surface and Overland Water Runoff' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/runoff-surface-and-overland-water-runoff): part of the precipitation runs off into streams and rivers, and part soaks into the soil (infiltration) and adds to groundwater. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Baie van die reën op 'n boer se lande was eens water in die see.
items.bron: Van der Ent, Savenije, Schaefli et al. (2010), Water Resources Research, 'Origin and fate of atmospheric moisture over continents' (https://infoscience.epfl.ch/record/162492?ln=en): on average 40% of precipitation over land comes from evaporation over land. The remaining roughly 60% therefore comes from the ocean. 'Baie' (not 'alles' or 'die meeste') is correct and appropriately careful. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Die water in strome en riviere vloei afdraand na laer plekke toe. Klein strome loop saam in groter riviere in. Uiteindelik vloei baie van die water weer terug na die see.
items.bron: USGS, 'Runoff: Surface and Overland Water Runoff' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/runoff-surface-and-overland-water-runoff) and USGS 'Oceans and Seas and the Water Cycle' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/oceans-and-seas-and-water-cycle): about a third of precipitation over land runs off through streams and rivers back to the oceans, and rivers and groundwater keep the oceans filled. 'Baie' holds. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Ons noem hierdie vierde stap afloop (invloei).
items.bron: 'Afloop' is the Afrikaans term for runoff, water flowing away over the land surface (USGS runoff page, above). 'Invloei' is ordinary Afrikaans for inflow into a water body, as used for example in Vaal Dam reports (Parys Gazette, https://www.citizen.co.za/parys-gazette/?p=105393). As a name in brackets for water flowing into rivers, lakes and the sea, its meaning fits the step. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Baie ander water verdamp weer voordat dit ooit by die see kom. By die see kan die water weer verdamp en die reis van voor af begin.
items.bron: USGS runoff page (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/runoff-surface-and-overland-water-runoff): about two-thirds of precipitation over land evaporates, is transpired or soaks into the soil instead of running off to the sea. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Die vier stappe van die reis is verdamping, kondensasie, neerslag en afloop.
items.bron: USGS Water Science School (evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff pages, above) names these four as core processes of the water cycle. The four-step model is a teaching model and not a complete list (infiltration, transpiration and groundwater flow are also part of it). The lesson itself names groundwater and transpiration ('plante') elsewhere, so the model does not claim to be the whole of it. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: 'n Siklus is 'n reeks stappe wat oor en oor in dieselfde volgorde gebeur. Daarom noem ons die water se reis die watersiklus.
items.bron: Vocabulary.com, 'cycle' (https://www.vocabulary.com/dictionary/cycle): 'a series of events that happen repeatedly in the same order'. Dictionary.com, 'cycle' (https://www.dictionary.com/browse/Cycle): events that 'repeat themselves in the same order'. The definition is correct. Mapping checked: the order holds for the cycle as a whole. A single drop can take shortcuts (precipitation that evaporates again straight away, or water that goes underground). The lesson itself says so in 'Terug na die see' and 'Waar die reën val', so a learner is not led to believe that every drop must pass through all four steps. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: 'n Siklus het nie 'n begin of 'n einde nie. Ons kon die druppel se reis net so goed by 'n wolk begin het.
items.bron: Vocabulary.com and Dictionary.com, 'cycle' (above): a closed, repeating series. The water cycle has no fixed starting point (USGS Water Science School, natural water cycle). Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: So kom die varswater in ons riviere en mere telkens weer terug.
items.bron: USGS evaporation and precipitation pages (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/evaporation-and-water-cycle; https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/precipitation-and-water-cycle): over land, precipitation routinely exceeds evaporation, so the water cycle keeps replenishing fresh water on land. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: Ons volg een druppel water op 'n lang reis wat by die see begin.
items.blok: Die reis begin by die see
items.bron: Mapping checked for the 'one drop' story. A drop does not stay intact (it becomes vapour, then many small droplets that grow together). The lesson says exactly that in 'Die reis begin by die see', 'Die damp koel af' and 'Van wolk tot reën', so the story device does not teach that the same drop stays whole. Sources as for the evaporation, condensation and precipitation items above. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: watersiklus: Die reis van water wat oor en oor verdamp, wolke vorm, as reën val en weer wegvloei.
items.bron: USGS Water Science School (evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff pages, above). The entry names only rain and not snow, which narrows it but is not false, because rain is by far the main form (Journal of Climate 2018, above). Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: verdamping: Wanneer water in waterdamp verander en in die lug opstyg.
items.bron: USGS, 'Evaporation and the Water Cycle' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/evaporation-and-water-cycle): evaporation is the process by which water changes from liquid to gas or vapour. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: waterdamp: Water in die lug in 'n vorm wat jy nie kan sien nie.
items.bron: London South Bank University, 'Water: steam' (https://water.lsbu.ac.uk/water/steam.html) and Dictionary.com, 'vapor' (https://www.dictionary.com/browse/vapor): water vapour is an invisible gas, and the visible 'steam' or cloud is condensed droplets. Correct, and consistent with 'onsigbare waterdamp' in the first block. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: kondensasie: Wanneer waterdamp afkoel en weer in klein waterdruppeltjies verander.
items.bron: USGS condensation page (copy at https://fdacourse.iri.columbia.edu/documents/M1U2_Clouds/Clouds_Readings/S3_Clouds_Readings/S3_Condensation_The_Water_Cycle_USGS.pdf): condensation is the process by which water vapour in the air changes into liquid water, the opposite of evaporation. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: neerslag: Water wat uit die wolke na die aarde val, soos reën en sneeu.
items.bron: USGS, 'Precipitation and the Water Cycle' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/precipitation-and-water-cycle): precipitation is water released from clouds as rain, freezing rain, sleet, snow or hail. 'Soos' marks the forms as examples, so the list does not have to be complete. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

items.bewering: afloop: Wanneer reënwater oor die land afdraand na strome, riviere, mere en die see vloei.
items.bron: USGS, 'Runoff: Surface and Overland Water Runoff' (https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/runoff-surface-and-overland-water-runoff): surface runoff is precipitation that moves over the land surface into streams, rivers and lakes instead of soaking in, and rivers carry it to the sea. Volledig nagegaan in hierdie rondte.

opsomming: All 24 claims in all six study blocks and six glossary entries were checked against sources in this round, and none is false or unsettled. The two comparisons (the cold glass, and drops too heavy for the air to carry) and the one-drop story hold under further reasoning, and the four-step model is presented as a model, with the lesson itself naming groundwater and water that evaporates before it reaches the sea.
